paragraphs.text: The Cosiman Reefs is a set of seven coral reefs located somewhere northeast of Etlan Shiis , likely in the northern part of the Voda Sea .

The area contains the Coral Caves and is home to a tribe of merfolk that appear to be independent of Vodalia . Each reef is protected by seven Metathran , a gift from Urza after he used the genetic material of Toraix , the would-be last aquatic Protector dragon of Cosiman to create the race of blue-skinned water-breathing humanoids. In a promise to Toraix's mother Maraavis , Urza swore to send the Metahtran to Cosiman reefs after they had finished their mission to repel the Phyrexians in the first Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .
